title: Caper flower and onycha: Stéphane Piquart's latest olfactory discoveries
summary: Having entered the world of perfumery through Australian sandalwood, Stéphane Piquart founded Behave in 2007 with the ambition of introducing the industry to original ingredients sourced through environmentally responsible practices. From the deserts of Saudi Arabia to the peat bogs of the Congo, he travels the world in search of exceptional natural materials, including Bushman Candle and Namibian myrrh.
